title: Quietly Chewy Korean Asian Chive Songpyeon
description: A traditional Korean dish featuring Asian chives and nuka pickle, perfect for a brunch mood, with a chewy texture and earthy flavor. This high-protein friendly dish is made in the form of songpyeon, a type of Korean rice cake.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the Korean rice flour and salt.
Gradually add in the water and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for about 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into small balls and flatten each ball into a disk shape.
Place a few leaves of Asian chives in the center of each disk.
Add a small amount of Nuka pickle on top of the chives.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Steam the songpyeon for about 15 minutes until they are cooked through.
Serve the songpyeon warm with a drizzle of sesame oil and a sprinkle of toasted sesame seeds and crushed black pepper.
